Pune, Maharashtra

Professional Summary
Results-driven Talent Acquisition Specialist with strong experience across recruitment, HRIS platforms, and B2B sales environments. Demonstrated ability to manage full-cycle Recruitment, optimize HRIS processes, and partner with hiring managers to reduce time-to-fill. Open to relocating to Kolkata or Bengaluru. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, Workday, HRIS, B2B Sales, Salesforce, Linux, Confluence, Jira

Work Experience

Talent Acquisition Specialist, Saffron Bank (Dec 2024 - Present)
- Managed full-cycle Recruitment for mid-to-senior banking technology roles, reducing time-to-fill by 18% through targeted sourcing and streamlined interview coordination using Workday.
- Partnered with hiring managers to define role requirements and implemented Talent Acquisition campaigns that increased qualified pipeline by 40% in Q1.
- Maintained candidate records and reporting in Workday and HRIS, producing weekly dashboards in Confluence for leadership review.

HR Executive, Pixelwave Studios (May 2024 - Nov 2024)
- Executed end-to-end Recruitment for creative and technical teams, improving offer acceptance rate by 12% through enhanced candidate engagement.
- Administered HRIS updates and maintained accurate employee data, reducing onboarding processing time by 20%.
- Coordinated interview schedules and documentation in Confluence and Jira to streamline communication between hiring teams.

Talent Acquisition Specialist, Capgemini (Jun 2022 - Apr 2024)
- Led Talent Acquisition efforts for IT services vertical, managing volume Recruitment campaigns and leveraging Workday and HRIS to track candidates and hiring metrics.
- Built relationships with university and campus partners to source early-career talent, increasing campus hire conversion by 25%.
- Created recruitment playbooks in Confluence and tracked requisitions and feedback workflows in Jira to improve process consistency.

Sales Manager, Zoho (May 2021 - May 2022)
- Managed B2B Sales accounts and enterprise pipelines, driving a 22% increase in quarterly bookings through targeted outreach and demo-driven conversions.
- Implemented Salesforce-based tracking and reporting to improve forecast accuracy and reduce sales cycle length by 15%.
- Coordinated cross-functional alignment between sales and product teams using Confluence to document account strategies.

Education
MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore
